citations.quote:
Orbit Works customer operations handbook. Reviewed 7 October 2026.

Our support team owns the first response to customer requests. A first reply should acknowledge the issue, identify the order and explain the next action. The daily queue rotates between the regional shifts; a queue owner is not automatically an approver.

Refunds above £750 require approval from the Payments Lead. Refunds of £750 or less can be processed by a Support Agent without further approval.

All refunds return to the original payment method. Partial refunds use the amount being returned, not the original invoice total. A refund must not be split to avoid the approval threshold. Keep the customer informed while approval is pending. Record the approval in the ticket before asking Finance to release funds.

For account access problems, send a password reset rather than requesting credentials. Complaints about billing accuracy go to the reconciliation queue. This handbook describes the approval role; consult the staffing register to identify its current holder.
citations.title: Customer operations handbook

citations.quote:
Subject: planned leave and operational cover

Noah Chen delegates his approvals to Mira Shah only from 1 October 2026 through 31 October 2026 inclusive. Outside those dates Noah Chen retains the approvals.

Mira has the necessary operational access during the cover window. The change is temporary and does not replace Noah's role appointment. Approval requests must still satisfy the policy threshold and be recorded in the normal ticket. The covering person should not change the refund method or split a request.

Jun Patel is available for incident coordination, but is not delegated approval authority by this notice. Contacting Jun about a delayed request does not authorize Jun to sign it. On return, Noah resumes the normal approval queue. This notice concerns operational approvals, not supplier invoice approvals.
